message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a magazine cover layout for "TEMPO" with a large, light blue masthead across the upper third. At the very top, text reads "SALING JEGAL FORMULA E" and "DILEMA SEKOLAH TATAP MUKA," separated by a slanted line. Below the masthead, a handwritten blue "50 TH" is visible.

The central composition consists of a large, dark blue silhouette of a man’s profile facing right, which serves as a frame for several elements. Inside the silhouette, three men's faces and torsos are rendered in a realistic, painterly style with a red and purple color palette. One man at the top left looks forward with an intense expression. To his right, another older man looks slightly downward. Occupying the lower foreground is a larger portrait of a third man, shown from a side profile looking right. 

In the bottom left corner, a detailed illustration of a multi-story building labeled "KPK" sits above a stylized cityscape at night. Small text indicates "13-19 SEPTEMBER 2021" and "RP 45.000." To the right, bold black text reads "AZIS LAGI LAGI AZIS," followed by a paragraph starting with "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi membidik Azis Syamsuddin..." and ending with "...di meja Firli Bahuri." A barcode and QR code are located in the bottom left corner against a red band.
